snippet.title: Life on the Hook — Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A quiet life by the lake.
Explore Life on the Hook on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148100/

Watch the release trailer for Life on the Hook, a short story about an elderly fisherman living alone in a small lakeside house, with a dock and an old boat.
